title: Existence of the descended relative Proj degree-one twist
statement: For a scheme S and a quasi-coherent graded affine-basis algebra A, there exist a module L on the relative Proj, chart isomorphisms from its tensor pullbacks to the degree-one twists, and for every affine U≤V normalized scalar-extension twist comparisons whose induced chart square commutes.

proof.text: Use scalar-extension comparisons on affine restrictions; their homogeneous-fraction formulas compose on refinements. Refine intersections by affine opens and apply module-sheaf object descent to obtain L and charts together with the normalized scalar-extension comparisons and commuting chart squares.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_twist_chart_descent_object :
    ∃ (L : A.relProj.Modules),
      ∃ (chart : ∀ U : S.affineOpens,
        (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (A.relProjι U)).obj L ≅
          Proj.twist (A.grading U) 1),
      TwistChartCompatibility A L chart
